WITH order_counts AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM `order`
    GROUP BY account_id
), averages AS (
    SELECT AVG(order_count) AS average_order_count
    FROM order_counts
), above_average AS (
    SELECT oc.account_id,
           oc.order_count,
           oc.order_count - a.average_order_count AS above_overall_average
    FROM order_counts AS oc
    CROSS JOIN averages AS a
    WHERE oc.order_count > a.average_order_count
), above_average_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(order_count) AS average_above_average_order_count
    FROM above_average
)
SELECT aa.account_id,
       aa.order_count,
       aa.above_overall_average,
       aa.order_count - aam.average_above_average_order_count AS above_above_average_mean
FROM above_average AS aa
CROSS JOIN above_average_mean AS aam
ORDER BY above_above_average_mean DESC
LIMIT 10
